% unnumbered-headings — a heading hierarchy with no section numbers.
%
% headings.tex covers the numbered case. An untagged file's headings are promoted
% where the document numbers them (DESIGN.md, Phase 5), so this one asks what is
% left without numbers: size and weight, which \section*, \subsection* and
% \subsubsection* set at three different steps, and the space around each.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{document}
\section*{Getting Started}

Install the tool and run it once with no arguments to see the list of commands.

\subsection*{Configuration}

Settings are read from a file in the home directory, and each can be overridden on
the command line.

\subsubsection*{Environment Variables}

A variable overrides the file but not the command line.

\section*{Troubleshooting}

Run the doctor command first, because it checks the common causes in order.
\end{document}
